desc: Design the sliding window algorithm using a two-stack queue: front stack for pops, back stack for pushes, each storing elements with their local prefix max and cumulative cost.
Implement push (right extension) and pop (left contraction) operations in O(1) amortized time, including computing total window cost on demand.
In the main loop, for each right pointer, push nums[right], then shrink from left while total cost > k, adding (right - left + 1) to the answer.
Test on the given examples (nums=[6,3,1,2,4,4], k=7 → 17; nums=[6,3,1,3,6], k=4 → 12) and edge cases (n=1, already non-decreasing, large drops).
Verify correctness with brute force on small random arrays to ensure no off-by-one or cost computation errors.
